SELECT id, attraction_name, cover_url, type, longitude, latitude, (6371000 * acos( LEAST(1, GREATEST(-1, cos(radians(#{userLat})) * cos(radians(latitude)) * cos(radians(longitude) - radians(#{userLng})) + sin(radians(#{userLat})) * sin(radians(latitude)) )) )) AS distance FROM tb_attraction
attraction_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyWord}, '%')
HAVING distance IS NOT NULL
AND (distance > #{lastDistance} OR (distance = #{lastDistance} AND id > #{lastId}))
ORDER BY distance ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
